name: Transport stage code qualifier
description: Code qualifying a specific stage of transport.

values.name: Inland transport
values.description: Inland transport Transport by which goods are moved from or to the frontier, or between inland points.

values.name: At the statistical territory limit
values.description: At the statistical territory limit Point by which the means of transport are presumed to have left the statistical territory of despatch or to have entered the statistical territory of arrival.

values.name: At arrival
values.description: At arrival Transport by which goods are moved to the place of arrival.

values.name: Means of transport at transit
values.description: Means of transport at transit The means of transport used to carry goods that have come under transit procedures of the customs administration to which a transit declaration is being made.

values.name: Means of transport crossing the regulatory border
values.description: Means of transport crossing the regulatory border The means of transport moving into and out of a regulatory territory.

values.name: Means of transport at first port of arrival into regulatory
values.description: Means of transport at first port of arrival into regulatory territory The means of transport moving into a regulatory territory at the first port of arrival.

values.name: Pre-carriage transport
values.description: Pre-carriage transport Transport by which the goods are moved prior to their main carriage transport.

values.name: At border
values.description: At border Transport by which goods are moved to the Customs frontier.

values.name: At departure
values.description: At departure Transport by which goods are moved from the place of departure.

values.name: At destination
values.description: At destination Transport by which goods are moved at the place of destination.

values.name: Main carriage - fourth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - fourth carrier The fourth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - fifth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - fifth carrier The fifth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - sixth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - sixth carrier The sixth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - seventh carrier
values.description: Main carriage - seventh carrier The seventh carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - eighth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - eighth carrier The eighth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main-carriage transport
values.description: Main-carriage transport The primary stage in the movement of cargo from the point of origin to the intended destination.

values.name: Main carriage - first carrier
values.description: Main carriage - first carrier The first carrier of the ordered transport when more than one carrier is involved.

values.name: Main carriage - second carrier
values.description: Main carriage - second carrier The second carrier of the ordered transport when more than one carrier is involved.

values.name: Main carriage - third carrier
values.description: Main carriage - third carrier The third carrier of the ordered transport when more than one carrier is involved.

values.name: Inland waterway transport
values.description: Inland waterway transport Transport by which goods are moved via an inland body of water.

values.name: Delivery carrier all transport
values.description: Delivery carrier all transport Carrier responsible from the point of origin to the final delivery destination.

values.name: Second pre-carriage transport
values.description: Second pre-carriage transport Second transport by which the goods are moved prior to their main carriage transport.

values.name: Pre-acceptance transport
values.description: Pre-acceptance transport The transport by which the goods are moved to the place of acceptance.

values.name: Second on-carriage transport
values.description: Second on-carriage transport Second transport by which the goods are moved after the main carriage transport.

values.name: Main carriage - ninth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - ninth carrier The ninth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: On-carriage transport
values.description: On-carriage transport Transport by which the goods are moved after the main carriage transport.

values.name: Main carriage - tenth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - tenth carrier The tenth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - eleventh carrier
values.description: Main carriage - eleventh carrier The eleventh carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - twelfth carrier
values.description: Main carriage - twelfth carrier The twelfth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Overflight
values.description: Overflight The movement of a conveyance through the airspace over the territories of a country without landing within the territories of the country.
